appln_title: CRANE, AND PATH GENERATION SYSTEM FOR CRANE
appln_abstract: A crane in which a boom that is capable of derricking and extending/retracting is provided to a swiveling base includes: an operable-range-setting unit that sets an operable range in which a load being transported can be transported, the operable range being set according to the weight of the load; a path generation unit that generates, within the set operable range, a plurality of nodes through which the load can pass and a plurality of paths connecting adjacent nodes; and a transport path determination unit that determines a transport path of the load on the basis of a priority sequence for actuating a plurality of actuators of the crane, the transport path satisfying a prescribed condition, and being determined from the generated plurality of nodes and plurality of paths.

appln_title: ROTATING DUCT TYPE ROTOR WITH SHROUD
appln_abstract: [PROBLEMS] To provide a rotor with a shroud operated on the driving principle of a linear motor stably rotatable even if the rotor is increased in size and used horizontally or the blowing direction thereof is rapidly changed. [MEANS FOR SOLVING PROBLEMS] In this rotating duct type rotor with the shroud, permanent magnets are disposed on the outer peripheral part of a rotating duct, a rotor blade having rotating support parts for suppressing deflection and warpage is connected to the inner peripheral part thereof at the intervals of generally 2.5 m, the shroud and the rotating duct are always brought into contact with each other in the vertical direction, and the extension/retraction of the rotating duct and the rotor blade properly hold a horizontal distance between the inner peripheral part of the shroud and the outer peripheral part of the rotating duct. Thus, even if the rotor is increased in size and used horizontally or is mounted on a turn table and the direction thereof is rapidly changed, the rotor can be stably rotated at all times and a lift and a thrust can be generated.

appln_title: Rapid disassembling structure of propeller and aircraft
appln_abstract: The invention discloses a rapid disassembling structure of a propeller and an aircraft. The rapid disassembling structure of the propeller comprises a base, a propeller seat, a locking member and a limiting subassembly, wherein a side wall of the base is provided with a through hole; the through hole is internally and slideably provided with a stop pin; the propeller seat is connected in the basein a sleeved manner and is provided with an open pore opposite to the through hole; the locking member is slideably or rotationally disposed at an outer side of the side wall and is matched with the stop pin so that one end, facing to an interior of the base, of the stop pin can slide into or out of the open pore; the limiting subassembly includes a limiting slot and a raised first limiting part which are respectively disposed on the base and the propeller seat; the first limiting part is clamped into the limiting slot along the sleeved direction to limit the base and the propeller seat to rotate circumferentially along the sleeved direction; the base and the propeller seat are respectively connected with a paddle and a driving member. According to one embodiment disclosed by the invention, the rapid assembling and disassembling for the propeller can be realized.

appln_title: Aircraft security alarm system
appln_abstract: An aircraft security alarm system uses proximity sensors mounted in adjacent pairs to any access area into an aircraft, The proximity sensors are connected electrically to a battery-powered control box with a miniature LED remote indicator light to identify that the system is activated. When any door or cover over an access area is moved, opened, or otherwise accessed, a switch in one of the pair of proximity sensors detects the movement. The proximity sensor sends a signal to the control box, which in turn triggers a high decibel/high pitch siren/horn that sounds indefinitely until the system is disarmed via a wireless remote control.

appln_title: Clevis assembly with bearing device in operable communication with a translating element, and fail-safe tail rotor system including the same
appln_abstract: According to an aspect, a clevis assembly includes a shackle having two ends, each end respectively including an aperture, a structure connecting the apertures and housing a bearing, and a shearing device that includes a frangible point and is in operable communication with the bearing, where the shearing device is housed in a hollow portion of the structure.

appln_title: SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR REGULATING A SENSOR ENCLOSURE
appln_abstract: Provided herein is a system and method for regulating a sensor enclosure of a vehicle. The system comprises an enclosure comprising a vent at a base of the enclosure, one or more sensors configured todetermine a parameter of the vehicle or the enclosure, a fan configured to regulate an internal temperature of the enclosure, and a controller configured to regulate a rotation speed of the fan basedon the parameter of the vehicle or the enclosure. The regulating system further comprises a deflector connected to the enclosure and configured to direct an airflow into the vent based on the parameter.

appln_title: SELF-POWERED RELEASABLE AEROSTAT AND METHOD AND SYSTEM FOR RELEASING AND CONTROLLING THE AEROSTAT
appln_abstract: A computer-implemented method for releasing and controlling an airship is provided. The method includes receiving instruction signals to release the airship for an autonomous flight, wherein the airship includes a plurality of body segments and a plurality of coupling elements for coupling adjacent body segments along a length of the airship. The method further includes determining environmental conditions affecting the airship, evaluating an internal pressure level of each of the plurality of body segments and a stiffness level of each of the couplings elements, and determining whether the evaluated internal pressure levels and stiffness levels are substantially suitable to the determined environmental conditions. The method further includes, determining whether the propulsion unit is in an operational state, and then based on the determination that the propulsion unit is in an operational state, triggering a disconnection of the tether unit and an activation of the auto pilot unit.

appln_title: Strain balance temperature influence calibration system
appln_abstract: The invention discloses a strain balance temperature influence calibration system, belonging to the field of test equipment for a flight test. The system comprises a support frame, a balance loading head and a weight loading mechanism, wherein the weight loading mechanism is provided with a weight loading unit and a lifting unit; the weight loading unit comprises a connecting rod, multiple weight disks sequentially arranged on the connecting rod along the length direction of the connecting rod, and multiple weights sequentially arranged along the arranging direction of the weight disks; a first counter bore is formed in the bottom surface of each weight; a first through hole is formed at the bottom of the first counter bore along the thickness of the weight; the diameter of the first counter bore is greater than the diameter of the weight disk; the diameter of the first through hole is less than the diameter of the weight disk; the connecting rod sequentially passes through the first through holes of the weights; the weight disks are positioned in the first counter bores of the weights and are in one-to-one correspondence to the first counter bores. By adopting the technical scheme, the system disclosed by the invention realizes automatic step loading or unloading of the weights and can adapt to different environment temperatures.

appln_title: Rotor blade with low Reynolds number
appln_abstract: The invention belongs to helicopter rotor blade design, and particularly relates to a pneumatic layout scheme suitable for a rotor blade with the low Reynolds number. The rotor blade with the low Reynolds number is constituted by three parts of a paddle root, a blade inner side and a paddle tip; and the position, with the maximum chord length, of the blade is located on the blade inner side, the distance between the front upper edge of the blade and the variable-pitch axis is smaller than the distance between the rear edge of the blade and the variable-pitch axis, and the position, with the maximum chord length, of the blade inner side is close to the paddle root and away from the paddle tip. According to the rotor blade with the low Reynolds number, by optimally designing the structure and shape of the blade, and especially the geometric profile and parameters of the blade, the pneumatic performance of the blade is improved, taking a certain full-aircraft 20-kg electric quad-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle as an example, by adopting the blade, the hovering time of the unmanned aerial vehicle exceeds one time the time of a conventional quadrotor, the effective load weight exceeds theload weight of a conventional rotor, thus the flight performance of a rotor craft is improved greatly, and large practical application value is achieved.

appln_title: Unmanned aerial vehicle flight control method based on imitation learning and reinforcement learning algorithms
appln_abstract: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle flight control method based on imitation learning and reinforcement learning algorithms. The method comprises the following steps: creating an unmanned aerial vehicle flight simulation environment simulator; defining a basic action set of flight; classifying the trajectory data according to the flight basic actions; for each flight action, learning mapping network parameters from a flight basic action to an original action by utilizing imitation learning; counting the minimum continuous action number of each basic action; constructing an upper-layer reinforcement learning network, and adding the minimum continuous action number as punishment p of aircraft action inconsistency; in the simulator, obtaining current observation information andawards, and selecting corresponding flight basic actions by using a pDQN algorithm; inputting the state information of the aircraft into an imitation learning neural network corresponding to the flight basic action, and outputting the original action of the simulator; inputting the obtained original action into a simulator to obtain observation and awards of the next moment; and performing training by using a pDQN algorithm until the strategy network on the upper layer converges.

appln_title: Unmanned aerial vehicle and unmanned aerial vehicle cleaning system and method
appln_abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides an unmanned aerial vehicle, an unmanned aerial vehicle cleaning system and a cleaning method. The unmanned aerial vehicle comprises a rack, a driving device, afixing frame, a cradle head and a water gun; the rack is provided with a first surface and a second surface which are oppositely arranged, the driving device is arranged on the rack, and the drivingdevice provides driving force for the unmanned aerial vehicle; the fixing frame is fixedly connected to the second face of the rack, the cradle head is fixedly connected to the face, away from the rack, of the fixing frame through a first connecting rod, a water gun is connected with the cradle head through a second connecting rod, the angle of the water gun can be adjusted along the cradle head,and the water gun is used for spraying water. The unmanned aerial vehicle is adopted to replace manpower to clean a to-be-cleaned object, and thus the cleaning efficiency and safety can be improved.

appln_title: Self-calibrating multi-sensor cargo handling system and method
appln_abstract: An autonomous cargo handling system having a sensor self-calibration system may comprise a sensing agent configured to monitor a sensing zone, and a system controller in electronic communication with the first sensing agent. The system controller may be configured to receive structural cargo deck data from the first sensing agent, generate a real-time cargo deck model, identify a cargo deck component in the real-time cargo deck model, and determine a position of the sensing agent relative to the cargo deck component.

appln_title: NACELLE FOR WIND TURBINE AND METHOD FOR TRANSFERRING COMPONENTS
appln_abstract: Aspects of the present invention relate to a nacelle (14) for a wind turbine generator (10), and a method for transferring components into and out of a wind turbine generator (10). The nacelle (14) comprises a housing (26) surrounding an internal volume (24) of the nacelle (14). The housing (26) has a maintenance opening (50). The nacelle comprises a carriage (54) configured to hold a component (48), the carriage (54) being movable between a first position and a second position to transfer the component (48) through the maintenance opening (50). When the carriage (54) is in the first position, the component (48) is held within the internal volume (24). When the carriage (54) is in the second position, the component (48) is held such that at least a portion of the component (48) is outside the housing (26).

appln_title: Mooring unmanned aerial vehicle connection balance system
appln_abstract: The invention discloses a mooring unmanned aerial vehicle connection balance system which comprises a rotary lantern ring. Adapter holes in bilateral symmetry are formed in the inner wall of the rotary lantern ring; a hinge seat is hinged to the interior of the rotary lantern ring through a transfer jack; a sliding cylinder is integrally formed on the lower side of the hinge seat; the upper end ofthe inner wall of the sliding cylinder is screwed with an electronic dynamometer; a connecting rod is welded at the lower end of the electronic dynamometer; the lower end of the connecting rod penetrates through the sliding cylinder and extends outside; and a mooring rope fixing hole is formed in the lower end of the connecting rod. The previous feedback information of a gyroscope is synthesizeddirectly according to the direction and the magnitude of the tension; therefore, the purpose of sharing the workload of the gyroscope processor is achieved. The structure directly detects the direction and magnitude of the force instead of detecting the deflection degree of the stressed aircraft body, and the feedback step is reduced in the processing link, so that compared with a mooring unmannedaerial vehicle balance system which completely depends on a gyroscope to adjust the balance, the mooring unmanned aerial vehicle balance system of the invention has higher data feedback and processing efficiency.

appln_title: Leveling control system and method for heavy equipment
appln_abstract: A leveling control system and method for heavy equipment, in which a lower frame having a traveling unit and an upper frame are combined together by a tilting unit. The system includes a sensor unit, provided in the equipment, for measuring twist angles of the lower frame and the upper frame against a reference horizontal surface and a traveling speed of the equipment, and detecting working state information of working devices; a control unit for receiving the twist angles, the traveling speed, and the working state information, calculating a correction angle for the leveling control of the upper frame, and generating a control signal for instructing an operation of an actuator in accordance with the correction angle; and a driving unit for performing the leveling through the actuator in accordance with the control signal received therein. The control unit is provided with an auto leveling mode module for performing the leveling against a reference horizontal surface, a re-leveling mode module for performing the leveling against the reference horizontal surface in a standstill state of the equipment for a limited time, and a track leveling mode module for performing the leveling against the lower frame.

appln_title: Anti-thunder method and system
appln_abstract: The invention relates to an anti-thunder method. The method comprises the following steps: performing the real-time tracking to thunderstorm through a thunder detection pre-warning system, while a thunder cloud approaches, remotely controlling an unmanned aerial vehicle thunder triggering system to be lifted and approaching the thunder cloud, wherein the unmanned aerial vehicle thunder triggeringsystem comprises at least one unmanned aerial vehicle and a mounted thunder triggering device, the thunder triggering device comprises a metal point end positioned at the top of the unmanned aerial vehicle, a metal lead connected with the metal point end and connected to the ground, the metal point end and the metal lead are used for performing the thunder triggering and neutralizing electric charge, releasing the energy, and realizing the active anti-thunder. The invention further provides an anti-thunder system. The anti-thunder system comprises the thunder detection pre-warning system, theunmanned aerial vehicle thunder triggering system, and an unmanned aerial vehicle remote control system. The unmanned aerial vehicle thunder triggering system comprises at least one unmanned aerial vehicle and the thunder triggering device. The thunder triggering device comprises the metal point end, the metal lead, and a grounding device. The anti-thunder method is capable of realizing the pre-triggering of the thunder by using the unmanned aerial vehicle to carry the metal lead to be lifted and approach the thunder cloud, neutralizing the electric charge of the thunder cloud, releasing the energy of the thunder cloud, and thereby realizing the active anti-thunder.

appln_title: Small propeller
appln_abstract: The invention provides a small propeller,which comprises two identical blades, one of the bladesis obtained by rotating the other blade for 180 degrees arounda rotation axis; each blade is composed oftwo curved surfaces of an upper surface and a lower surface; from the blade root to the blade tip, the upper curved surface is always convex upwards from the leading edge to the trailing edge; from the blade root to the position of 50% of a radius, the lower curved surface is convex downwards; from the position of 50% of the radius to the blade tip, the lower curved surface is convex downwards atthe position of 10% of the chord length of the leading edge and concave inwards from the position of 10% of the chord length to the trailing edge, and the degree of concave gradually increases from 50% of the radius to the blade; the chord lengths of the bladesgradually increase from the outside of the rotation axis to 50% of the radius; the chord lengths of the blades gradually decrease from 50%of the radius to the blade tip; the maximum chord length is at the position of 50% of the radius and is 15% of the radius, the minimum chord length is at the blade tip and is 6% of the radius. According to the small propeller, the tension coefficient, the power coefficient, and the hover efficiency are evidently improved, and the aerodynamic efficiency is evidently improved.

appln_title: Mobile station for an unmanned vehicle
appln_abstract: A mobile station for an unmanned vehicle comprises a vehicular storage area for storing a vehicle during transit or at rest. A first wireless transceiver communicates a status or command between the vehicle and the mobile station during at least one of vehicular deployment and rest. A station controller manages a management plan of the vehicle comprising at least one of retooling the vehicle, loading a payload on the vehicle, and recharging or refueling of the vehicle.

appln_title: Efficient VTOL resource management in an aviation transport network
appln_abstract: A transport network management system identifies a service objective for a plurality of VTOL aircraft and retrieves VTOL data including locations of the plurality of VTOL aircraft. An estimate of demand for transport services to be provided at least in part by one of the VTOL aircraft is generated and routing data for the plurality of VTOL aircraft is determined based on the estimated demand and the service objective. Routing instructions based on the routing data are sent to at least a subset of the VTOL aircraft.

appln_title: GAS SUPPLY STRUCTURE OF FUEL CELL POWER PACK
appln_abstract: The present invention relates to a gas supply structure of a fuel cell power pack, comprising: a gas supply unit connected to a regulator valve coupled to a gas tank inserted into a case, and disposed inside the case to supply fuel gas to a stack unit disposed inside the case; and a pressure unit having one side fixed to the inside of the case while the other side is connected to the gas supply unit, and pressurizing the gas supply unit in the direction of the regulator valve. According to the present invention, it is possible to enhance user convenience through a gas supply structure that can be easily attached to and detached from.
